assessor: Single Codex assistant in the current session; both extractor labels visible; no external models or human legal experts.

verdicts.supported: Extracted material propositions are stated or faithful paraphrases; concise nonmaterial omissions and broad topic naming do not count as errors. Does not certify exhaustive extraction.
verdicts.material_error: At least one definite source contradiction, invented material condition/citation, reversed scope or duty, or material qualification omitted from a rule that becomes broader. Record field, extracted value and verbatim source evidence.
verdicts.uncertain: Source fragment or cross-reference insufficient for a confident judgement; do not infer external law or count uncertainty as support.
verdicts.empty_no_rule: No rule extracted; distinguish parse failure and empty nonoperative source from substantive extraction omission. If substantive propositions missing, report separately as missing_material_content.
